notes.title: New update for SOUND FORGE Audio Studio 14 Steam Edition!
notes.content:

MP3 file support - Removed need to activate MP3 Codec, which fixes import / export issues

notes.title: New update for SOUND FORGE Audio Studio 14 Steam Edition!
notes.content:
Important changes in version 14.0.0.75 compared to version 14.0.0.66

VST processing at mono sources fixed
Markers & regions
  - Extended marker id numbers range
  - Show 3 digit marker numbers from now (1 ... 999)
  - Show larger id numbers within tool tip only (1000 ...)
  - Not displayed large id number of just added region in the region list fixed
  - Possible crash while deletion of to many region list entries fixed
Visualization
  - Old channel meters are available again
  - Red colored max value when reaching the clipping value in new channel meter
  - Oscilloscope improvements
Missing program name in 'About' menu entry and dialog fixed
Damaged colors after standby or renewed user login fixed
Elastique Pro update to version 3.3.2
Possible crash when closing the program via the task bar fixed
WMA now available for conversion in Audio Studio context menu
